text_block_list.text:
In the morning, while getting ready in my 
room...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer! It's morning, good morning~!
(Click...)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, excuse me!
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ What do you think happened? Take a 
guess!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The hint is~ something that'll make 
Trainer super-duper happy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because look how well it turned out! I 
even used my prized special carrots!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, carrots! I made sure not to eat them 
and saved them for later~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh, I just want you to see it already! 
Hey, hey, I'm just gonna give it to you 
now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! Here is some Urara-brand chocolate 
for you, Trainer!

What Haru Urara handed to me was quite... 
or rather, extremely orange chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, looks delicious, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day is when you give 
chocolates to people who take care of you, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I worked super hard making this 
last night!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I ground the carrots up like whirrr, and 
tossed them into the chocolate like 
plop-plop-plop!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd be happier with carrots in 
it too, Trainer! Hey, hey, are you happy?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~. You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'm heading out to hand these 
out to everyone in the shopping district 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you come along too, Trainer? I'm 
sure everyone would love to have you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yay! Let's go get the chocolates, then!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I made sure the chocolates for everyone 
are amazing too! I bought different 
flavors from different shops!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Veggies from the greengrocer, fish from 
the fishmonger, and meat from the 
butcher—put 'em all in!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! I can't wait to see 
everyone's smiles!

Afterward, I went to the shopping district 
with Haru Urara and spent a lively 
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, try a bite! It's gonna blow your 
mind, I swear!
Urged on by Haru Urara, I took a bite...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, ehehe~♪ Guess what, guess what? 
I've got a delicious secret!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's actually a secret, but if you really 
want to know, Trainer, I'll tell you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What'll it be? Wanna know?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~n! Sure thing! Now, lend me your 
ear!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Um, you see...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I put tons and tons of love into it, 
hoping it would make you smile, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪ The good luck charm was a huge 
success!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And also, as thanks for telling you, you 
could totally give me a bite, you know!

Afterward, I spent a delightful 
Valentine's Day sharing carrot chocolates 
with Haru Urara.
